prompt: Realistic illustration of rats, cats, and dogs playing together inside a cozy house interior. Warm golden indoor lighting creates an inviting atmosphere with soft shadows from lamps and windows. Multiple animals having fun in humorous playful interactions: fluffy white cat batting at toy mice, small brown rat chasing after it playfully, energetic beagle dog jumping through the air trying to catch everyone, another black-and-white tabby cat diving for a squeaky toy while rats scatter around furniture legs. Detailed fur textures on all animals - soft whiskers on cats and dogs, sleek shiny coats on rodents with visible individual hairs catching warm light. Funny expressions: wide excited eyes, open mouths mid-chase, playful ears flopping back from movement. Cozy room setting includes wooden coffee table scattered with toys, comfortable armchairs in the background, bookshelves lining walls, rug covering hardwood floors. Dynamic composition showing motion blur on moving animals to convey energy and fun. Humorous scene where all species are friends playing together peacefully indoors.
